summary: No. 5 Indiana (6-0, 22-game win streak) hosts No. 4 Ohio State (5-1) at noon on FOX as roughly a 3-3.5 point home underdog with a total of 50.5; SP+ projects a 26-26 tie. Ohio State's injury list has six players out, including starting OT Austin Siereveld (now out, second straight game missed) and RB Ja'Kobi Jackson, plus five questionable players such as RB Isaiah West.

legs.note: SP+ projects a 26-26 game, Indiana is unbeaten at home and won the last meeting, and Ohio State is missing a starting tackle and RB depth. Covers, Yahoo, BUSR and TheSpread all lean Indiana; at -110 this beats the +3.5 at -124.

Last meeting finished 13-10 and both defenses are elite, but Covers takes the Over (Indiana 15-8 to the Over in Big Ten play under Cignetti) while BUSR/GoldSheet (24-20) and Yahoo take the Under. Weak lean only; the market looks efficient.

extra_legs.note: Smith averages about 153 yds/gm (823 over his first five games, then 93 vs Maryland), but Cignetti is building the game plan around stopping him, and his line is already set high. That roughly cancels out, so this is close to a coin flip.

Hoover is averaging 227 yds/gm (1,364 yards, 17 TD, 0 INT, 88/129) mostly against weaker defenses. Ohio State's pass defense and the low-scoring 2025 meeting point a little lower, but the edge is small.

2. History: Indiana beat OSU 13-10 in the 2025 Big Ten title game, and OSU managed only 58 rush yds on 26 carries; Indiana is 15-8 to the Over in Big Ten play under Cignetti (Eleven Warriors, Covers).
3. Coaching: Day says last year doesn't matter and that the OL 'has a plan'; Cignetti's defense can pressure without blitzing, and Sayin's completion rate drops about 20% under pressure (Sportsnaut, Eleven Warriors).
4. Matchups: Sayin and Jeremiah Smith vs IU secondary (Smith leads the FBS: 823 yds and 9 TD through 5 games); Hoover has 17 TD and 0 INT vs an elite OSU defense; the trenches are the key battle (ESPN, Eleven Warriors).
5. Health: OSU lists six players out, including OT Austin Siereveld (now out, second straight game, not day-to-day) and RB Ja'Kobi Jackson; five questionable including RB Isaiah West; Day: 'Will we be 100% healthy? Probably not.' Indiana TE Andrew Barker is out and RB Khobie Martin doubtful (Eleven Warriors, Yahoo, Inside the Hall).
6. Stats: Hoover 1,364 yds, 17 TD, 0 INT in 6 GP (IU stats); Sayin 1,772 yds, 17 TD, 2 INT; Smith about 153 rec yds/gm; SP+ projection 26-26 (Inside the Hall).
7. Weather: No reliable game-day forecast found; mid-October noon kickoff, assume mild and not a factor.
8. Experts: Covers has Indiana +3.5 and the Over; Yahoo has Indiana +3.5 and Under 51.5; BUSR has Indiana +3.5 and Under 50.5 (GoldSheet projects IND 24-20); TheSpread backs the Indiana home dog. Consensus is Indiana ATS, split on the total.
9. Line movement: OSU opened/held at -3.5 at DraftKings, with some books now at -3 (TheSpread -3 at -105); total 50-51.5; NBC listed OSU ML -180, now about -150, which suggests movement toward Indiana. No public betting splits found.
